sources.title: Qwen - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: On 24 March 2025, Alibaba launched Qwen2.5-VL-32B-Instruct as a successor to the Qwen2.5-VL model. It was released under the Apache 2.0 license. [25][26] On 26 March 2025, Qwen2.5-Omni-7B was released under the Apache 2.0 license and made available through chat.qwen.ai, as well as platforms like Hugging Face, GitHub, and ModelScope.

sources.title: qwen2.5:7b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 models are pretrained on Alibaba's latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18 trillion tokens. The model supports up to 128K tokens and has multilingual support.

sources.title: QwenLM/Qwen2.5 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen2.5 represents the latest generation in the Qwen language model series, released in September 2024. It consists of dense, decoder-only language models designed for a wide range of natural language processing tasks, including text generation, conversation, tool use, and role-playing.
